targets.outcome_reasoning: Rule 1: the author explicitly judges the experiment overall not to meet the preset successful-replication criterion. This overall verdict takes precedence over component results: smiling replicates, while face rubbing and foot shaking do not in the main analysis; exploratory analyses recover foot shaking. Low power is discussed as a limitation but not as an overall inability to adjudicate.
